title: Preserve Wolfram plotting intent
objective: Route core Wolfram plotting and Graphics composition through an ordered option/provenance spine, preserve nested directive scope and stable PlotSpec intent, and diagnose every unsupported option without changing established Plotly happy paths.

oracles: Existing Wolfram Plotly traces plus focused option precedence/provenance fixtures

handoff.summary: Wolfram Plot, Graphics, Graphics3D, and Show now lower through one ordered PlotCall spine that retains the frontend head, complete source expression, range text, filename/source span, Rule versus RuleDelayed records, and per-option translation outcomes. Runtime option translation applies deterministic last-occurrence precedence without duplicate Python keywords, emits stable PLOT_OPTION_IGNORED diagnostics for unsupported options, attaches Wolfram provenance and intent through the public Graphics/Graphics3d context hook, preserves layer IDs across Show, and treats nested color/opacity directives with lexical scope. Existing Plotly rendering stays unchanged on supported happy paths. Focused native-disabled lowering/runtime tests, existing graphics rendering, strict Python, architecture checks, the full build, and the polyglot benchmark pass.
risks: The required broad integration receipt reports 49 failures outside this lane because the worktree intentionally lacks the complete optional native-kernel/FFLAS/igraph/m4ri publication set and because the integrated multiprocessing runtime references an undefined TYPE_CHECKING binding. Wolfram dashboard, PlotSpec core, Graphics, Graphics3d, export, and the focused Wolfram suite pass in that same workspace.

RuleDelayed is retained as explicit ordered source intent, including its span and translation event, but the current foreign frontend still evaluates its option value eagerly at the Python call boundary; true held/re-evaluated Wolfram semantics require a later evaluator lane.
Only linux-x64 was executed locally; the implementation is ordinary TypeScript and strict Python with native-disabled coverage, but the remaining declared platforms depend on CI.
The shared frontend plotting inventory must classify the newly advertised Show head; the integration lane owns that shared-file update alongside MATLAB regeneration.
next_steps: Classify Show as supported composition in tools/foreign/plotting-surface.cjs and regenerate the shared checked plotting inventory in the central integration lane.
Build the next Wolfram plotting lane on PlotCall translation events, prioritizing high-value options and constructs without weakening stable ignored-option diagnostics.
Add a held-expression evaluator boundary before claiming full RuleDelayed reevaluation compatibility.
